item.title: Implement the specified token bucket rate limiter
item.brief: Implement the rate limiter in ratelimit.py according to the repository's SPEC.md, replacing all stubs. Follow every specified validation and edge case: positive capacity/refill rate; bucket starts full; continuous fractional refill capped at capacity; atomic failed acquisition; validate n <= 0 or n > capacity with ValueError; wait_time validates identically and never consumes; backward clock movement neither changes tokens nor moves the latest observed time backward. Implement KeyedLimiter with independent TokenBucket per hashable key, max_keys validation, LRU eviction on creation when full, and both try_acquire and wait_time counting as use; evicted keys restart full; len reports tracked keys. Keep standard-library-only and preserve the public API. Check behavior beyond the basic tests, including validation, fractional refill, backward time, non-consuming wait_time, and LRU ordering; run the relevant tests and commit the finished change as requested.

pr.body: Implemented continuous fractional refill capped at capacity, full initial buckets, atomic acquisition, validation, non-consuming wait_time, and monotonic handling of backward clock observations. KeyedLimiter uses independent buckets and LRU eviction, with both operations updating recency. Added edge-case unit tests. Checks: python -m unittest -v (7 passed), python -B -m py_compile ratelimit.py test_ratelimit.py, and git diff --check all passed. Assumptions: capacity and request sizes may be fractional, as the specification permits continuous fractional token balances.
pr.summary: Implemented token bucket and keyed LRU rate limiting. Callers can acquire tokens, inspect availability and wait time, and bound per-key state. Before: all methods were stubs and all three baseline tests errored; now: all seven tests pass.
